steps.title: Prepare Sample in Tin Boat
steps.instruction: Weigh 7 mg (+/-0.2mg) of sample into a tin boat using a microbalance (e.g., Mettler Toledo XPR2).

substeps.instruction: Use tin boats sized 8 x 8 x 15 mm (Isomass Scientific Inc. Catalog #D5032) or 12 x 4 x 4 mm (Isomass Scientific Inc. Catalog #D5130).
Gently and carefully close the boat with tweezers.
Slowly press the boat using the pressing tool to remove remaining air.

steps.title: Verify Gas Pressures and Flow Rates
steps.instruction: Check the manometers and main screen to ensure gas pressures and flow rates are correct.

substeps.instruction: Verify Helium pressure is 1.2 bar (99.999%, Catalog #HE5.OUH-T).
Verify Oxygen pressure is 2 bar (99.993%, Catalog #OX4.3UH-T).
Verify TCD flow is 200 mL/min.
Verify Helium flow is 200 mL/min.
Verify Oxygen flow is 13 mL/min.

steps.title: Verify Instrument Temperatures and Maintenance
steps.instruction: Ensure the instrument has reached operating temperatures and is maintained.

substeps.instruction: Check that the combustion tube temperature is 950°C and the reduction tube is 550°C (modify via Options > Settings > Parameters if necessary).
Click 'Maintenance' on the main screen; if components are orange, contact the lab manager.
Open the front door of the Vario MICRO Cube to check the drying tube: if it is 2/3 blue, contact the lab manager; if mostly white, proceed.

steps.title: Perform Rough Leak Test
steps.instruction: Execute the system leak test via the software.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Option -> Diagnostics -> Rough leak test.
Press OK and wait 10 minutes for columns to cool.
Confirm 'Leak test passed' appears, then click Cancel. Contact lab manager if the test fails.

steps.title: Configure Analysis Table
steps.instruction: Enter the sample and blank information into the software table rows.

substeps.instruction: Rows 1-6: Weight 100 mg, Name 'MT', Method 'Blank without O2'.
Rows 7-8: Weight of 2 acetanilide boats, Name 'RunIn', Method '2mgChem70s'.
Rows 9-10: Weight 100 mg, Name 'Blank', Method 'Blank with O2'.
Rows 11-12: Weight of 2 acetanilide boats, Name 'acetanilid', Method '2mgChem70s'.
Rows 13-23: Weight of prepared boats, Name 'Sample name', Method '9mgPlant90s'.
Row 24: Weight 100 mg, Name 'Blank', Method 'Blank with O2'.
Note: For multiple series, place 2 blanks (Blank with O2) and 1 acetanilide (2mgChem70s) between every 10 samples. The final row must be a blank.

steps.title: Run Initial Blank and Calibration
steps.instruction: Perform the initial blank run to verify system baseline.

substeps.instruction: Click Yes in the software.
Wait approximately 3 minutes until the ads. column temperature is below 30°C, then press Start.
Press the green button to start analysis (duration approx. 36 minutes).
Verify that N Area and C Area results are below 100 after a few analyses; otherwise, contact the lab manager.

steps.title: Load Samples and Start Analysis
steps.instruction: Place the prepared boats into the carousel and initiate the run.

substeps.instruction: Place boats in carousel holes corresponding to the software row numbers.
Leave carousel holes empty for blank rows.
Replace the carousel cover.
Press the green button to start the analysis.

steps.title: Export Data and Save Project
steps.instruction: Export the results and archive the run information.

substeps.instruction: Go to File -> Export/Import -> Export sheet data (for Excel).
Click 'All samples removed from the carousel' and choose 'Reference run'.
Enter the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and project/student name, then press Save.
Select 'Labo Laliberté' and the project/student, then press Enregistrer.

steps.title: Shut Down Instrument
steps.instruction: Place the instrument in sleeping mode before leaving.

substeps.instruction: Click the moon icon on the main screen and select 'Sleep now...'.
Select 'Confirm actions...', click 'Close', and then 'Finish'.
